loss: daily arithmetic mean of individual squared errors across each system's frozen seed trajectories; deterministic systems have one trajectory; seeds are fixed, never resampled for temporal comparisons
estimand_change: mean_date(mean_seed(squared_error)) differs from original mean_seed(sqrt(mean_date(squared_error))) and from squared ensemble error; no original RMSE margin applied to MSE units

dm.H0: mean daily loss difference equals zero
dm.interval: nominal unadjusted 95pct HLN_t interval for mean MSE difference

mcs.model_p: cumulative maximum of sequential EPA p-values

friedman.scope: conditional optimization seed-rank diagnostic, never market inference
friedman.blocks: six numeric seed identifiers shared a priori by thirteen neural recipes
friedman.deterministic_comparators: excluded; never copied to create trials
friedman.metric: original per-seed RMSE computed arithmetically from frozen predictions
friedman.omnibus: Friedman tie-corrected and Iman-Davenport F approximation; validity requires independent seed vectors and exchangeable within-block rankings under H0
friedman.posthoc: two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm78, only if Iman-Davenport p<0.05; report conditional symmetry and pairing assumptions and small-n resolution
friedman.if_not_admissible: report rank descriptions and explicit limitation; no iid quarter substitution
friedman.permutation: 10000 within-row independent model-label permutations; conditional exchangeability null; plus-one tail p

limitations: one asset and one shared test chronology
weak dependence/local stationarity assumptions and adequate block/HAC span required
conditional seed diagnostic is not Friedman across independent datasets
no guarantee of generalization, equivalence, absence of overfit, or prospective success
prohibited: treat dates or calendar quarters as independent Friedman blocks
